title: Bellweather
opening: You arrive on Bellweather's green with an apple in your pocket. A crooked weathercock turns above the bakehouse. Someone has chalked a very small hopscotch court beside the well. The river makes a lazy bend below the village; an unfinished boat rests on its bank. You have the day to yourself.

green.name: Village green
green.desc: Grass worn into paths around a covered well. Chalk squares, a broad oak, and a bench in the sun.

oak.name: Under the oak
oak.desc: A low branch makes a natural seat. Acorns, beetles, and the view of people's shoes crossing the green.

workshop.name: Mara's workshop
workshop.desc: Wood shavings, boat ribs on trestles, a patient kettle. A pegboard holds tools in silhouettes drawn by a child.

workshop_yard.name: Workshop yard
workshop_yard.desc: Offcuts sorted by length, a uselessly small gate, and an empty stretch of level earth beside the fence.

bakehouse.name: Bakehouse
bakehouse.desc: Warm brick, flour on the doorstep, a counter of rolls. Through a back window you can see the orchard.

loft.name: Bakehouse loft
loft.desc: Dry sacks, a round window, and a chest containing battered wooden masks. Room enough to rehearse something ridiculous.
loft.blocked: The loft door is shut; its keeper can invite you upstairs.

orchard.name: Orchard
orchard.desc: Small sour apples and a fallen trunk. A wash-line runs between trees; no two clothespins match.

chapel.name: Open chapel
chapel.desc: White walls, a cracked sundial in the porch, and a bell that sounds unexpectedly like a saucepan.

tower.name: Bell tower
tower.desc: A sound little bell with a loose wooden clapper brace. Below lie the village roofs, the river, and the wide meadow.

garden.name: Chapel garden
garden.desc: Beans climb crooked sticks. A patch has been left entirely to dandelions. A garden wall warms in the sun.

meadow.name: Long meadow
meadow.desc: Grass, crickets, a wind good for kites, and a footpath that does not insist you follow it.

landing.name: River landing
landing.desc: A boat drawn onto rollers, a stout mooring post, and a plank landing. Minnows hide under its shadow.

boathouse.name: Boathouse
boathouse.desc: An upturned skiff, old oars, coils of rope, and a table with a board marked for a game nobody has finished.

reedbank.name: Reed bank
reedbank.desc: Reeds tick together. A shallow side stream leaves a dry gravel bar within stepping distance.

gravel_bar.name: Gravel bar
gravel_bar.desc: Flat skipping stones and driftwood. One willow bends almost horizontally over the stream.

willow_nook.name: Willow nook
willow_nook.desc: A dry hollow behind the willow roots. Tiny clay houses stand on shelves of bark; a town built for beetles.
willow_nook.blocked: A tangle of willow roots conceals what lies behind it.

road.name: Lane beyond the meadow
road.desc: The lane climbs between hedges. Bellweather remains plainly visible behind you.

crossroads.name: Crossroads
crossroads.desc: Two roads continue beyond the village. You can choose to leave for good, or turn back and spend more of your day here.

apple.name: a small apple
apple.desc: A pocket apple, a little bruised.

chalk.name: a stub of chalk
chalk.desc: Left on the green for anyone's use.

offcuts.name: a bundle of offcuts
offcuts.desc: Scrap wood freely available for making things.

flat_stone.name: a flat river stone
flat_stone.desc: Smooth enough to skip or paint.

twine.name: a ball of twine
twine.desc: A shared ball on the boathouse table.

brace.name: a wooden clapper brace
brace.desc: Mara made this for the chapel bell. It fits two slots without tools.

pitch.name: a pot of boat pitch
pitch.desc: Enough pitch to seal the boat on the landing.

bun.name: a warm bun
bun.desc: Pip has set this one aside for a visitor.

loft_key.name: the bakehouse loft key
loft_key.desc: A brass key with a loop of red thread.

paddle.name: a short paddle
paddle.desc: Nella keeps it for a little boat.

candle.name: a beeswax candle
candle.desc: Small enough for a leaf lantern.

clay.name: a lump of river clay
clay.desc: Ida keeps it damp in a piece of cloth.
